meta.description: Bends paths at a few spots, like a stem that changes its direction a little where a branch grows out. Gives the bent paths and the kinks as points, with their direction pointing to the outer side of the bend.

amount.description: How many kinks every path gets.

lowestKink.description: Where the first kink sits. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

highestKink.description: Where the last kink sits. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

angle.description: How far the path bends at every kink, in degrees. Everything above the kink turns by it.

rotation.description: How far every kink is turned around the path from the one before it, in degrees. 180 bends left and right in turn, 137.5 makes a spiral.

depth.description: On how many of the deepest layers of paths to put kinks.
